citation.title: Effects of Meal Frequency on Metabolic Profiles and Substrate Partitioning in Lean Healthy Males

population.description: Twelve healthy non-smoking European men, weight stable, BMI up to 25, max age 40, healthy by questionnaire, blood pressure and OGTT (Table 1 age 23±1.2 y and BMI 21.6±0.6 kg/m2, mean±SEM, ranges 18-31 and 19.1-24.6). SD computed as SEM x sqrt(12): age 1.2 x 3.4641 = 4.157; BMI 0.6 x 3.4641 = 2.078.

protocols.name: fasted_baseline
protocols.description: Fasting blood sample of the 12 men (Table 1 baseline; Table 1 does not say when it was drawn: the screening OGTT section says a fasting sample was taken after an overnight fast, and chamber mornings also had a fasting sample, but the table does not name either), modelled as a short fasted morning arm with water only

protocols.name: screening_ogtt
protocols.description: Screening OGTT: after an overnight fast (hours and clock time not stated; the paper says they came to university in the morning), a bolus of 75 g glucose dissolved in 250 ml water at t = 0, blood sampled every 30 min until t = 120 min

findings.description: Fasting plasma glucose, Table 1 baseline (Table 1 does not name the draw or its assay)

location.where: Table 1, row 'Fasting glucose level (mmol/L)', column Group (n = 12); footnote: values are mean±SEM

findings.description: Fasting plasma insulin, Table 1 baseline (Table 1 does not name the draw or its assay)

location.where: Table 1, row 'Fasting insulin level (mU/L)', column Group (n = 12); footnote: values are mean±SEM

findings.description: Plasma glucose 2 h after the 75 g screening OGTT (the sample at t = 120 min); the paper states no cut-off for the screening

location.where: Table 1, row '2 h glucose level after OGTT (mmol/L)', column Group (n = 12); footnote: values are mean±SEM

findings.description: Systolic blood pressure at baseline. Table 1 states neither the time nor the posture of the measurement.

location.where: Table 1, row 'Systolic blood pressure (mm/Hg)', column Group (n = 12); footnote: values are mean±SEM

findings.description: Diastolic blood pressure at baseline. Table 1 states neither the time nor the posture of the measurement.

location.where: Table 1, row 'Diastolic blood pressure (mm/Hg)', column Group (n = 12); footnote: values are mean±SEM

left_out.what: Plasma glucose, insulin, FFA, TG, GLP-1 active, ghrelin active, adiponectin 24 h profiles, LFr vs HFr (Figures 1-2)

Energy expenditure, RMR, SMR, DIT, protein/carbohydrate/fat oxidation per 24 h on 3 vs 14 meals (Table 2): the day's energy is given only as an individually set mean intake of 12.0 MJ/d (SMR x 1.55) and an example diet of 2400 kcal, 15/30/55 En%, with meals at 08:00, 12:00, 17:00 (3x) or hourly 08:00-21:00 (14x); the split of energy over the eating occasions is not stated. RMR and SMR in Table 2 are per diet, from the chamber day (RMR a regression intercept including DIT), not a fasted morning value
24 h plasma glucose AUC per diet (Results text, 7276.1 vs 7664.6): the unit is printed as mmol/L, with no time unit
CGMS glucose mean, min, max, AUC, CONGA, CV (Table 3): interstitial sensor glucose
